definitions.ask: Should an unknown positional `#name` report `section_tag_unknown` only when it is a near miss of a section tag?
definitions.why: #word is already an ordinary Obsidian tag in Bryan's comments (#a, #b); flag likely typos only

choices.label: Only typo-like near misses report, with a did-you-mean hint; other hashtags stay quiet
Every unknown positional #name reports, so #a-style tags in sectioned PDFs add noise

definitions.requested: Also, add a great glossary memory web entry for "annotation section".
